title: prd
description: Product requirements: what is built, why, and how it is known to be done. The background, goals with their measures, the scope with its actors, functional and non-functional requirements by priority, each with the acceptance criteria that verify it, constraints, a glossary, open questions, and sections of your own. How it is built belongs to a tech-spec.

status.description: Where it stands, such as Draft or Agreed, over the title

owner.description: Who wrote it or owns it

summary.description: A sentence or two under the title; a line of Markdown

related.description: Documents it leads to or answers to, such as the tech-spec and the design that meet it

background.description: What is wrong today, and why it is worth building

goals.description: Under the title, each measure large over its goal

measure.description: How it is measured, short, such as from 900 a month to 200; a line of Markdown

items.description: What the system does; a line of Markdown
What it leaves out, though one might expect it; a line of Markdown

actors.description: Who uses the system, drawn beside the scope

role.description: What they do with it; a line of Markdown

functional.description: Each a card in the lane of its priority, its acceptance criteria under it

id.description: FR-1, FR-2 and on, each once

title.description: What it lets someone do; a line of Markdown

text.description: More of it; a line of Markdown

nonfunctional.description: Each a card in the lane of its priority, its acceptance criteria under it

id.description: NFR-1, NFR-2 and on, each once

target.description: The value to meet, short, such as p95 under 2 s

items.description: What the work must keep to; a line of Markdown

open.description: Questions not answered yet; the options are weighed in a tech-spec or a design

more.description: Sections of your own after the rest, each a heading over parts

acceptance.description: The acceptance criteria that verify the requirement, numbered AC1, AC2 and on under it; one that verifies two requirements is written under both. A requirement without them is marked so

given.description: What holds before; a line of Markdown

when.description: What someone does; a line of Markdown

then.description: What is expected to come of it; a line of Markdown
